name: Grimtotem Satchel
summary: The Grimtotem Satchel is a leather pouch clutched by the fallen tauren Maur Grimtotem deep inside Ragefire Chasm. Even as troggs overwhelmed him in the subterranean cavern beneath Orgrimmar, Maur shielded this pack with his dying breath. Recovering it and returning it to Thunder Bluff reveals that Elder Crone Magatha Grimtotem had an active interest in whatever her clansman carried.

sections.title: A Dying Grip
sections.body: Discovered beneath the broken body of Maur Grimtotem in the depths of Ragefire Chasm, this simple pack was held in a fierce, vice-like embrace. Maur fought desperately to protect whatever it contains while surrounded and slain by savage troggs. The sheer determination required to shield a satchel above one's own life suggests its contents are far more significant than ordinary trail rations or supplies.

sections.title: The Elder Crone's Interest
sections.body: Upon carrying the satchel to Rahauro on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, the greater mystery unfurls. Rahauro accepts the pack on behalf of Magatha Grimtotem, the matriarch of the Grimtotem clan. Maur was Magatha's servant, and word had reached her that he found something peculiar in the caverns below Orgrimmar before he died; Magatha specifically arranged rewards for its safe return, demonstrating that the Grimtotem leadership had deliberate, covert stakes in the trogg-infested chasm.

faq.q: Where is the Grimtotem Satchel found?
faq.answer: The satchel is discovered deep inside Ragefire Chasm, the volcanic cavern beneath Orgrimmar. It lies tucked under the corpse of Maur Grimtotem, pinned in his arms where he fell to the cavern's troggs.

faq.q: Who does the satchel belong to?
faq.answer: It belonged to Maur Grimtotem, a member of the Grimtotem clan who ventured into Ragefire Chasm. Even in death, his arms remained tightly wrapped around the pack to protect its contents from the attacking troggs.

The satchel is delivered to Rahauro on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. Rahauro accepts it under the direct orders of Magatha Grimtotem, who arranged a reward for anyone who recovered her fallen clansman's belongings.

faq.q: Why was a Grimtotem carrying this under Orgrimmar?
aliases: what was the grimtotem doing in orgrimmar
faq.answer: Maur Grimtotem was a servant of Magatha Grimtotem, who had taken an interest in Ragefire Chasm. He went into the chasm to speak with the troggs and found something peculiar there, but he never made it out to show her what.
The exact contents inside the pouch are kept sealed and are handed directly to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff. Magatha hopes it holds signs of the peculiar thing Maur found in the chasm.

angles.text: Finding a Grimtotem operating deep beneath Orgrimmar and reporting back to Magatha on the Elder Rise highlights the subtle, uneasy political maneuvers of the Grimtotem within the united tauren tribes.
The discovery of a dead Grimtotem courier deep in the tunnels beneath Thrall's capital shows that the perils of Ragefire Chasm extend far beyond simple beast infestations.
